No one is going to be paying $7 a week for no ads. We want a lifetime one-time payment option. With the amount of players you guys have on a daily basis I don’t think it’s unreasonable for lifetime ad-free to cost between $5-$8.

author: sarakelleysunshine
title: A 5-Star Game Ruined by 1-Star Ads
content:
I genuinely LOVE this game. The cats are adorable, the puzzles are fun and relaxing, and this could easily be a 5-star app. Unfortunately, the advertising is absolutely excessive.

There is an ad after nearly every puzzle, and many aren’t simple ads—you have to wait, hit multiple X’s, get redirected to the App Store, and fight your way back to the game. At some point I’m spending almost as much time navigating ads as I am playing.

What’s especially frustrating is that the App Store presentation makes the game look much more polished and themed than the fairly basic experience you initially get, while also listing Premium and Premium Plus subscriptions. I would happily pay a reasonable one-time fee for an ad-free version of the game I already enjoy. I don’t want another $8–$15 monthly subscription just to play a casual puzzle game without being bombarded with ads.

The developers have something genuinely good here. The cats got me to download it and the puzzles made me want to stay. The advertising is what is making me want to delete it. Please offer a straightforward, reasonably priced ad-free purchase.

title: In game chat bot help (mostly) useless
content:
The in game support is useless, it directs me to the oversimplified rules, then ignores me if I ask for clarity or additional help.
12 hours and still waiting for a reply
(Ana responded after 11.5 hours)

Example: the rules and “how to play” articles say nothing about the three available tools:

Cat
Lightbulb
Mouse

(According to Ana: “When you use the mouse icon item, it will indicate which cells do not contain a cat, helping to assist you in progressing through the game smoothly.”)

What is so challenging about explaining features in the Help Tab!

I’m getting in-game praise & ❤️’s after my wins by other players (that haven’t been online in hours, so I’ll assume they are bots.) Is there a gameplay use for ❤️’s ?
I can give other players ❤️’s, when I click on my ❤️icon, the number of ❤️’s decreases by one, but I don’t see anything else. 

Cute & artsy is not a substitute for clarity, I know Apple insists it is with their software … it is not!

Update:
I heard from a game team
“…The hearts and encouragement messages are intended as light social interactions between players, but we understand the current presentation may feel confusing or unclear.”

title: Listen Meowduko…

82 day streak and level 1,946. Could be higher if I didn’t have a life.

I tire of closing out the app (needless to say 2 apps with the Walmart ad) and reopening it after every level. I used to put on airplane mode just to avoid it.

The leaderboard, all fake of course. At the moment, if this app is rated anywhere above #10, you absolutely should have the ability to make at least a real leaderboard. I mean it’s something simple people want to see. 

Nevertheless, I just downloaded Zooduko and 10 levels in, still no annoying ads. 

Maybe I’ll circle back to Meowduko after they’re done with all the unnecessary UI updates every 5 days and added fake bot interaction.
